svg.aria-label: docker compose up: builds the node and python servers, waits for their healthchecks, then the k6 container runs 7 scenarios one at a time and writes JSON, per-scenario dashboards and reports/index.html
svg.title: docker compose up: builds the node and python servers, waits for their healthchecks, then the k6 container runs 7 scenarios one at a time and writes JSON, per-scenario dashboards and reports/index.html
svg.text: One command: build both servers, wait until they are healthy, run 7 scenarios one after another, write the reports.

text.tspan: (≈5 min): each wagon is 8 VUs hammering one endpoint for 30 s

svg.text: not in parallel, so scenarios never fight over CPU
Reports land in reports/ on your machine
